sentences.text: Hungarosaurus was a quadruped whose body was covered in hundreds of osteoderms, which are bony plates embedded in the skin.
Mature specimens of this animal reached a length of about 4 to 4.8 meters.
Estimates place the weight of Hungarosaurus between 650 and 1000 kilograms.
It possessed unusually long forelimbs that were nearly as long as its hindlimbs.
The ornamented skull of Hungarosaurus was estimated to be 32 to 36 centimeters long.
Ankylosaurian fossils in Europe have been found in England, Austria, western Romania, France, and northern Spain.
The species was named by Attila Ősi in 2005.
The specific name 'tormai' honors amateur paleontologist András Torma, who discovered the fossil site in 2000.
Four specimens were collected from an open-pit bauxite mine near Iharkút in the Bakony Mountains of western Hungary.
Dental wear evidence suggests Hungarosaurus sheared its food rather than just pulping it.
Hungarosaurus used a masticatory process involving an initial slicing phase followed by a retractive powerstroke with significant occlusion.
Cladistic analysis indicates Hungarosaurus is a derived member of the family Nodosauridae.
Hungarosaurus lived during the Santonian stage of the Upper Cretaceous.
The fossil record for Hungarosaurus spans from 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago.
